Source: rebeckerspecialties/mlmodelc-export commit f958affe4cc8d26776d090f27bf244840887fca2.
Vendored while the nested-block exporter prerequisite is awaiting release, so this RustNN branch and deployed binaries do not depend on a sibling checkout. Replace with the released crate after the prerequisite lands.

Local delta on top of that commit (to be upstreamed before the next crate release):
- types.rs: `MILType.state` and `MILType::into_state`; `state<tensor<...>>` text form.
- decoder.rs: `ValueType.stateType` (field 5) wrapping a tensor type.
- description.rs: `FeatureType.stateType` (field 8), `ModelDescription.state` (field 13) and
  `FunctionDescription.state` (field 6) as `FeatureDescription.state` / `FunctionDescription.states`.
- emitter.rs: operations without outputs (`write_state`) are emitted as bare calls.
- bundle.rs: state inputs leave `inputSchema` and are listed under `stateSchema` in metadata.json;
  a synthesized description encodes states with `StateFeatureType`.
